meta.description: Scan your medicine, hear how to take it in your language, and get a reminder when it is time.

header.languageHint: Choose the language for this app
header.readAloudUnavailable: Reading aloud is not available in this browser yet.
header.voiceMissing: This device has no {language} voice yet. Read the card, or ask your pharmacist.

landing.lead: Scan a label and hear it in Igbo, Yoruba, Hausa, Pidgin or English. Get reminders on any phone. Your pharmacist sees when you need help.
landing.previewLabel: Live preview · One prescription, five languages
landing.previewVoiceMissing: No {language} voice on this device yet. Read the sentence instead.
landing.howTitle: From the pharmacy counter to the right dose at home
landing.howIntro: Four steps, no reading required. Every step works offline and falls back to SMS.
landing.step1Body: Point the camera at the label or prescription. AI reads drug, dose and NAFDAC number.
landing.step2Body: Instructions are spoken in your language, in plain words.
landing.step3Body: Reminders by app, SMS or voice call. Caregivers alerted if a dose is missed.
landing.step4Body: Danger words like “chest pain” alert your pharmacist and show the nearest clinic.
landing.viewsIntro: Each hospital gets its own verified space. Staff and patients are checked against the hospital's records.
landing.viewsPatientsDoes: Scan, listen, ask by voice, check in
landing.phoneTitle: No smartphone? No data? Still covered.
landing.phoneBody: Reminders arrive by SMS or voice call. Reply 1 when you've taken it. The app also works offline and syncs later.
landing.phoneSms: 08:00 Mama Nkechi, take Lisinopril 10mg now. Reply 1 if taken, 2 if not.
landing.phoneFigure: A basic feature phone showing the SMS reminder and the reply “1”.
landing.safeIntro: The AI explains and reminds. Decisions stay with licensed professionals.
landing.safe1Body: No prescribing, no dose changes. Unclear questions go to your pharmacist.
landing.safe2Body: Emergency words are caught before any AI runs.
landing.safe3Body: Consent first, encrypted records, download or delete your data.
landing.safe4Body: Forum posts only from licensed MDCN, PCN and NMCN professionals.
landing.ctaTitle: See it work in under a minute.
landing.ctaBody: Pick a role: patient, pharmacist or hospital admin.
landing.previewAudioSoon: Audio for this language is coming. Read the sentence for now.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Pick your hospital and what you do there. We check your details on the hospital's list, then text a code to the phone number the hospital has for you.
signup.hospitalHint: Can't see your hospital? It has not joined Medisent AI yet. Ask the records desk.
signup.noHospital: No hospital — I manage my own medicine
signup.fullNameHint: Write it the way the hospital wrote it, for example Chidinma Okafor.
signup.staffIdHint: The ID on your hospital badge, for example AH-PH-001.
signup.hospitalNumberHint: On your hospital card, for example AH-0002.
signup.phoneHint: The number you gave the hospital. The code goes to that number, not to a new one.
signup.phoneHintIndependent: We will text the code to this number.
signup.languageHint: The app will talk and write to you in this language.
signup.consent: I agree that Medisent AI keeps my details and medicines to remind me and to help my hospital care for me (NDPA 2023). I can download or delete my data at any time.

rejected.label: Not matched
rejected.title: We could not find you on the hospital's list
rejected.body: The name, ID and role you typed do not match the hospital's list. Check the spelling of your name and your ID, then try again. If you are sure they are right, ask the records desk at your hospital to check the list.
rejected.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {No more tries. This ID is now blocked.} one {You have # more try. After that this ID is blocked and the hospital admin must unblock it.} other {You have # more tries. After that this ID is blocked and the hospital admin must unblock it.}}
rejected.tryAgain: Check my details and try again

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.title: This ID is blocked for now
blocked.body: Three tries did not match the hospital's list, so we stopped for safety. We have told the hospital admin. Go to the records desk at your hospital with your ID; they can unblock you.

exists.label: Already registered
exists.title: You already have an account
exists.body: An account already exists for this ID. If it is yours, sign in with your phone number. If it is not, tell the records desk at your hospital today.

errors.hospitalRequired: Pick your hospital from the list, or choose 'No hospital'.
errors.hospitalNotApproved: This hospital has not been approved yet. Ask the records desk when it will be.
errors.roleRequired: Tell us what you do: patient, doctor, pharmacist, nurse or hospital admin.
errors.staffNeedHospital: Hospital staff must pick their hospital. Only patients can sign up without one.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box to agree, then press Continue.
errors.nameRequired: Type your full name as the hospital wrote it.
errors.phoneInvalid: Type an 11-digit Nigerian number, for example 0803 000 0000.
errors.noPhoneOnFile: The hospital's list has no phone number for you, so we cannot send a code. Ask the records desk to add your number, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: You waited more than 30 minutes, so we stopped for safety. Fill the form again.
errors.notConfigured: This app is not fully set up yet, so sign-up does not work. Tell the person who runs it.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side, not yours. Press Continue to try again. Your details are still here.
errors.licenceMismatch: This licence number is not the one on the hospital's list. Check it, or ask the records desk.

signup.licenceBodyHint: MDCN for doctors, PCN for pharmacists, NMCN for nurses.
signup.licenceNoHint: We keep the number on the hospital's list.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Type the phone number or email on your account. We will text a code to that phone.
login.unverified: Your account is not confirmed yet. Try again after the hospital confirms you.

pending.label: Pending
pending.title: Your account is waiting for verification
pending.body: The hospital has not confirmed you yet. Try again tomorrow, or ask the records desk to check.

rejected.label: Not matched
rejected.title: We couldn't match you
rejected.body: This account did not match the hospital's list, so it cannot sign in. Go to the records desk at your hospital with your ID.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.title: This account is blocked
blocked.body: This account is blocked for safety. Go to the records desk at your hospital with your ID; they can unblock it.

errors.identifierRequired: Type your phone number or email.
errors.identifierInvalid: That is not a phone number or an email. Type 11 digits like 0803 000 0000, or an email with @.
errors.noAccount: There is no account with that number or email. Check it, or create an account.
errors.noPhoneOnFile: This account has no phone number, so we cannot send a code. Ask the records desk to add one.
errors.notConfigured: This app is not fully set up yet, so sign-in does not work. Tell the person who runs it.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side, not yours. Press the button to try again.

registerHospital.title: Register your hospital
registerHospital.intro: Tell us about the hospital and the person who will manage it. We review the licence and approve within two working days.
registerHospital.name: Hospital name
registerHospital.cacHint: The Corporate Affairs Commission number, for example RC 123456.
registerHospital.brandColorHint: Shown as a thin line under the header on every screen.
registerHospital.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
registerHospital.licenceHint: PDF or photo, up to 10 MB. Only the platform admin sees it.
registerHospital.adminIntro: This person signs up as the hospital admin after approval and uploads the staff and patient lists.
registerHospital.staffIdHint: Any ID your hospital uses, for example AH-AD-001. You sign up with it later.

done.label: Sent for review
done.title: Thank you. We are reviewing your hospital.
done.body: {hospital} is now pending. We sent an SMS with the staff ID to the admin's phone, and we send another when the review is done, usually within two working days.
done.staffId: After approval, sign up as hospital admin with staff ID

roster.title: Staff and patient lists
roster.intro: Upload a CSV for each list. New rows are added; rows with an existing ID are updated.
roster.fileHint: Up to 5 MB. The first row must be the column names.

staff.label: Staff roster
staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Doctors, pharmacists, nurses and admins who may sign up. Staff match by staff ID, role and full name.

patients.label: Patient registry
patients.title: Patients
patients.body: Patients who may sign up. They match by hospital number and phone.

errors.fileTooBig: The file must be under 5 MB.
errors.tooManyRows: Upload at most 5000 rows at a time.
errors.rowsInvalid: Some rows need fixing before we can save.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

issues.roleInvalid: role must be doctor, pharmacist, nurse or hospital_admin
